text: MD Anderson, the Houston Dynamo front sponsor, is part of the University of Texas System.
short: MD Anderson is part of the University of Texas System.

source.name: UT MD Anderson – About UT MD Anderson ('Part of the University of Texas System')
source.quote: Part of the University of Texas System, UT MD Anderson is one of the world’s most respected centers devoted exclusively to cancer patient care, research, education and prevention.

additionalSources.name: Houston Dynamo FC – 'Houston Dynamo FC launch Mission Control kit, inspired by Houston’s pioneering spirit in space exploration'
additionalSources.note: Supports the 'Houston Dynamo front sponsor' part of the claim: the club's 2026 kit launch names MD Anderson as front-of-kit sponsor.
additionalSources.quote: Notably, The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center returns as the front of kit sponsor, and teammates from MD Anderson joined Dynamo players in modeling the jersey.
